zabbix.description: Zabbix (monitoring - included since several labs use it as a network-monitoring target, not network gear itself). Real image sourced 2026-09-17 from Zabbix's own official appliance download page (cdn.zabbix.com/zabbix/appliances/stable/7.0/7.0.30/zabbix_appliance-7.0.30-qcow2.tar.gz, sha256-verified against Zabbix's own published checksum) - free, no vendor account needed (Community Edition). Live-boot-verified through netplex's real platform (rule #58): reaches the real Rocky Linux 8.10 'appliance login:' prompt with nginx and the Zabbix Agent both started - no profile drift needed, this device already matched the vendor reference template. Wave 38.12/NPX-1167.
